title: CreatorCraft 2
description: The ultimate modpack for creators! Including mods like Flashback, Motion Capture, Better Chroma Key (for green screen), and more!
body:
# Summary

CC2 is a more refined and themed modpack compared to CC1 designed to be the only content creation modpack you'll ever need! Packed with mods like Flashback to get those true cinematic shots, Motion Capture when you need multiple people in a scene but are friendless (someone call speed), Skin Shuffle to easily swap skins, Better Chroma Key for green/blue screens the list goes on! Also modrinth mods please don't suspend me for the metadata if its wrong cuz I chose the best one that I think is correct but I honestly don't know which one to choose. Sorry.
